tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and conditions as per tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: General background and experience of consultants (Limited to max. 10 marks). Threshold: 5 Years (Maximum of 5 marks) 2 Addl. point for every additional 1 year experience (Maximum 2 mark)

Relevant experience in design of similar nature of projects (Govt. Institutional works) (Threshold:1 Major projects costing 25.00 crores 20 marks and 2 addl. Marks for every addl. Project costing more than 5 crores, limited to max. 25 marks) In the Similar Nature of work done certificate given by Govt Institutions the project cost should also be mentioned in the certificate and the same should be attached.

Relevant experience in design of other projects (other than Govt. Institutional works).(Threshold : 1 project Rs. 500.00 lakh 5 marks and 2 addl. Marks for every addl. Project of Rs. 100.00 lakh, limited to max. 10 marks) In the Similar Nature of work done certificate given by other than Govt Institutions the project cost should also be mentioned in the certificate and the same should be attached
The Architect Firm should be empaneled with the Council of Architects, New Delhi. The copy of the Empanelment should be uploaded
Manpower details-Qualifications: BE(Arch)/BE(civil)/Staff (Threshold: Min.10 Nos- 10 marks and addl. 2 Marks for every addtl experts, limited to Max. 15 marks)
Awards/Appreciation letter from State Govt./Any Organization/ISO certificate

Turnover from consultancy services during the 5 years, i.e 20-21, 21-22, 22-23, 23-24 & 24-25 (Threshold: Rs.500.00 lakhs in any one year. 10 marks and 2 Addl. Marks for every addl. 5.00 lakhs rupees of turnover, limited to max. 15 marks) Certified Turnover statement issued from Chartered Accountant to be uploaded
